nodes.summary: For groups $G$ and $S$, $S$ is a composition factor of $G$ when there are subgroups $H$ and $K$ of $G$ such that $H$ is subnormal in $G$, $H \cap K$ is normal in $H$, and the quotient $H/(H \cap K)$ is a simple group isomorphic to $S$.
nodes.title: Composition factor of a group (Kourovka 17.92)

nodes.summary: A subgroup $H$ of a group $G$ is a Hall subgroup when its order $|H|$ is coprime to its index $|G : H|$.
nodes.title: Hall subgroup (Kourovka 17.92)

nodes.summary: A subgroup $H$ of a group $G$ is a Hall subgroup when its order $|H|$ is coprime to its index $|G : H|$, where an infinite order or index is counted as $0$.
nodes.title: Hall subgroup (Kourovka Problem 19.109)

nodes.summary: A group $G$ has this property when $G$ is not soluble and every maximal subgroup of $G$ is a Hall subgroup.
nodes.title: Non-soluble groups with Hall maximal subgroups

nodes.summary: A subgroup $H$ of a group $G$ is pronormal in $G$ when for every $g \in G$ there is an element $x$ of the subgroup $\langle H, gHg^{-1} \rangle$ generated by $H$ and $gHg^{-1}$ such that $xHx^{-1} = gHg^{-1}$.
nodes.title: Pronormal subgroup

nodes.summary: A subgroup $K$ of a group $G$ is second maximal when it is a maximal subgroup of a maximal subgroup of $G$: there is a maximal subgroup $M$ of $G$ with $K < M$ and no subgroup $L$ of $G$ with $K < L < M$.
nodes.title: Second maximal subgroup

nodes.summary: Every non-abelian composition factor of a finite non-soluble group all of whose maximal subgroups are Hall subgroups is isomorphic to $L_2(7)$, $L_2(11)$ or $L_5(2)$, so the first half of the answer to Kourovka 17.92 holds. Here $L_n(q)$ is the projective special linear group $\mathrm{PSL}_n(\mathbb{Z}/q\mathbb{Z})$, the quotient of $\mathrm{SL}_n(\mathbb{Z}/q\mathbb{Z})$ by its centre.
nodes.title: Maslova's theorem on groups with Hall maximal subgroups

nodes.summary: The proposition that every non-abelian composition factor of a finite non-soluble group all of whose maximal subgroups are Hall subgroups is isomorphic to $L_2(7)$, $L_2(11)$ or $L_5(2)$. Here $L_n(q)$ is the projective special linear group $\mathrm{PSL}_n(\mathbb{Z}/q\mathbb{Z})$, the quotient of $\mathrm{SL}_n(\mathbb{Z}/q\mathbb{Z})$ by its centre.
nodes.title: Kourovka 17.92, first half: the possible composition factors

nodes.summary: Each of $L_2(7)$, $L_2(11)$ and $L_5(2)$ is a composition factor of some finite non-soluble group all of whose maximal subgroups are Hall subgroups, so the second half of the answer to Kourovka 17.92 holds. Here $L_n(q)$ is the projective special linear group $\mathrm{PSL}_n(\mathbb{Z}/q\mathbb{Z})$, the quotient of $\mathrm{SL}_n(\mathbb{Z}/q\mathbb{Z})$ by its centre.
nodes.title: The three answer groups of Kourovka 17.92 occur

nodes.summary: The proposition that each of $L_2(7)$, $L_2(11)$ and $L_5(2)$ is a composition factor of some finite non-soluble group all of whose maximal subgroups are Hall subgroups. Here $L_n(q)$ is the projective special linear group $\mathrm{PSL}_n(\mathbb{Z}/q\mathbb{Z})$, the quotient of $\mathrm{SL}_n(\mathbb{Z}/q\mathbb{Z})$ by its centre.
nodes.title: Kourovka 17.92, second half: the three factors occur

nodes.summary: It is not true that for every non-abelian finite simple group $G$, all maximal subgroups of $G$ are Hall subgroups if and only if every second maximal subgroup of $G$ is pronormal in $G$.
nodes.title: Negative answer to Zenkov's question (Kourovka Problem 19.109)

nodes.summary: For every non-abelian finite simple group $G$, all maximal subgroups of $G$ are Hall subgroups if and only if every second maximal subgroup of $G$ is pronormal in $G$.
nodes.title: Zenkov's question on Hall maximal subgroups (Kourovka Problem 19.109)
